title: His Bundle Recording From Subclavian Vein
brief_summary: His bundle pacing has been proposed as a superior alternative to standard right ventricular pacing. The purpose of this study is to investigate whether obtaining a His Bundle recording from the subclavian vein using a stylet driven pacemaker lead and commercially available sheath can be done in a quick and reliable manner. This would support the use of stylet driven leads for His bundle pacing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age ≥ 18 years Male or Female Patients undergoing HIS bundle recording from the subclavian vein using a stylet driven pacemaker lead and commercially available sheath

Exclusion Criteria:

Patients who are unwilling or unable to sign the informed consent Pregnant women
study_population: Patients undergoing permanent pacemaker implantation identified by the TriHealth Heart Institute Electrophysiologists
